safety_verdicts.content: Patient has tried E45 cream and antihistamines with minimal relief.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated notes an OTC cream with no benefit but does not specifically include E45 and does not include antihistamine trial/minimal relief as in Gold.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the specific OTC trials (E45 and antihistamines) reduces the usefulness of the history for gauging prior treatment response and symptom control (e.g., itch), but it is unlikely to directly change safety-critical decisions in a straightforward contact dermatitis presentation.
